concerns.text: Task T035 implements only the one-sample t-test. It omits the mandatory Shapiro-Wilk normality test and the conditional branching to switch to Wilcoxon signed-rank test if normality is rejected, directly violating FR-005's requirement: 'one-sample t-test (or Wilcoxon signed-rank test if normality is rejected by Shapiro-Wilk test, p < 0.05)'.

Task T034 is marked 'REDO' with missing input artifacts (data_availability_gap_report.json, data_integrity_report.json) and lacks explicit logic to filter the dataset list before applying Benjamini-Hochberg. This creates a semantic gap where FR-006's requirement to 'apply FDR... to the correlation p-values' cannot be satisfied if the input data is not pre-filtered as mandated by the task description itself.

FR-001 mandates re-computing the 'Frozen Baseline' for ALL datasets to ensure consistency in the Recovery Ratio denominator. Task T019a generates a 'primary seed only' artifact, while T019d generates 'sensitivity/aggregation' metrics. The task list fails to explicitly state which artifact (T019a or T019c/T019d) serves as the definitive denominator for the Recovery Ratio calculation in T031, creating ambiguity that risks violating the 'consistency' constraint of FR-001.

Spec US-003 Acceptance Scenario 1 requires correlation analysis on 'the first 20 available datasets (alphabetically)' with a fallback to 'all available'. Task T024 is scoped to 'ALL available datasets' without any logic to enforce the 'first 20' subset or alphabetical ordering. This silently relaxes the specific sample size constraint defined in the spec, potentially violating the experimental design if the full set is processed when only a subset was intended for the primary analysis.
